descriptionChirho: Temporal adverb meaning 'the day before yesterday' or 'three days ago,' almost always in the idiomatic phrase תְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם (temol shilshom) meaning 'formerly, previously, in time past.'

A single occurrence glossed as '[previously]' in English/Spanish but as '[thirty]' in Hindi/Arabic/Swahili, suggesting possible confusion with שְׁלֹשִׁים (sheloshim, 'thirty') or an unusual contextual rendering; semantically still temporal but set apart by divergent multilingual evidence.
